data.name: Blusink
data.description: Blusink is a London-based ocean CDR startup founded in 2022 that deploys engineered seafloor substrates ("Blusinkies") to enhance ocean alkalinity and restore rhodolith beds, combining carbon sequestration with marine biodiversity restoration. The company has early deployments in Colombia, the Maldives, Portugal, and Japan, and is running a mesocosm experiment with Plymouth Marine Laboratory to quantify chemical and biological carbon removal effects.
